name: Bazarr
description: Subtitles for your movies and shows, found automatically.
compose:
services:
  bazarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bazarr:latest
    container_name: bazarr
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:6767"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - /srv/media:/media
